result:
All 14 queries have run and give plausible answers. I haven't checked V13's totals or V11's result by hand against the data. In V2, the null-customer and missing-country orders count under "unknown", and the other three countries have two orders each.

V1: get /data/orders | filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
V2: get /data/orders | map ~(query /customer/country "unknown" | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy | map ~(count)
V3: filter ~(get /active | eq true) | filter ~(get /roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | map ~(get /name) | sort ~(lower)
V4: filter ~(query /age | ne null) | map ~(get /age) | avg | round 1
V5: map ~(query /address/city) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(lower) | distinct | toVec | sort
V6: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ":" | drop 1 | join ":" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | filter ~(ne "") | distinct | toVec) | flat | groupBy | filter ~(count | gte 2) | keys | map ~(toString) | sort
V7: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 | map ~(count)
V8: lines | filter ~(contains "req=") | map ~(capture #"req=(?<id>\w+).*duration=(?<d>\d+)ms") | sort ~(get /d | toNumber | desc) | take 3 | map ~(get /id)
V9: get {:a (query /dependencies {}) :b (query /devDependencies {})} | unionOf /a /b | entries | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | sort | join ","
V10: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(query /assignee/login | coalesce "unassigned") | map ~(map ~(get /number) | sort)
V11: any ~(allOf (get /state | eq "closed") ~(query /assignee | eq null) ~(get /labels | map ~(get /name | lower) | contains "bug"))
V12: :d (get /defaults/timeout) | get /services | filter ~(query /enabled | ne false) | map ~(query /timeout | coalesce d)
V13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | map ~(get {:region /0 :rev (get /3 | if (eq "") ~(0) ~(toNumber)) :p (get /4 | toNumber)}) | map ~(get {:region /region :rev (mulOf /rev /p)}) | groupBy /region | map ~(map ~(get /rev) | sum | round 2) | entries | map ~(get {:region (get /0 | toString) :revenue /1}) | sort ~(get /revenue | desc) | take 2
V14: "1:ann:82;2:Bob:69;3:cy:70;4:dora:91;5:Ed:55;6:fred:70" | split ";" | map ~(split ":") | filter ~(get /2 | toNumber | gte 70) | map ~(get /1 | upper) | sort | join "|"
